title: Geology of the ACE Basin, Beaufort, Charleston, and Colleton Counties, South Carolina (This Open-File is a compilation of Dale, Wiggins, Bennetts Point, Edisto Island, Beaufort, Frogmore, St. Helena Sound, Edisto Beach, Parris Island, St. Phillips Island, and Fripps Inlet 7.5-minute quadrangles)
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2004, Geology of the ACE Basin, Beaufort, Charleston, and Colleton Counties, South Carolina (This Open-File is a compilation of Dale, Wiggins, Bennetts Point, Edisto Island, Beaufort, Frogmore, St. Helena Sound, Edisto Beach, Parris Island, St. Phillips Island, and Fripps Inlet 7.5-minute quadrangles): South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-150, map scale 1:62,500.
notes:
Single compilation map sheet read from OCR (page 1); compiled from eleven 7.5-minute quadrangles, scale 1:62,500. No map symbols are tied to unit descriptions in the OCR text (one stray 'QPps'), so none were recorded. The Water unit was not recorded; Karst is a nonsedimentary map unit and was recorded. Legend-only features (roads, photo locations) were not recorded. Units are grouped by the terrace they lie beneath, with terrace margin elevations in each terrace record's contacts. Two thicknesses with OCR'd digits ('less than | foot', '4 to 5) feet') are read as likely digits, flagged inferred and sent to review. The introductory text on the coastal zone is general and was not recorded.
SUBSURFACE: Karst area: limestone, calcareous silt and calcareous silty sand less than 40 feet beneath the surface under Beaufort, Port Royal and Ladies Island (an areal statement, not tied to a point; page 1). A schematic diagram of the terrace systems (Port Royal, Pamlico, Princess Anne, Silver Bluff, Modern) and an idealized facies diagram are printed without elevations or distances (page 1). No drill holes, structure contours or measured cross sections appear in the OCR text. Datum: not stated.
Re-read of page 1 for subsurface fields (single compilation map sheet from eleven 7.5-minute quadrangles, scale 1:62,500, read from OCR). Units as before (grouped by the terrace they lie beneath); map symbols, not tied to descriptions in the OCR, read from the legend boxes on page-image tiles (mud flat box reads QHp, molluscan conglomerate QHs). Terrace margin elevations (Holocene <10 ft landward; Silver Bluff 6/10 ft; Princess Anne 12/18 ft; Pamlico 17/25 ft; Port Royal >25 ft seaward) recorded as contacts and as stated unit tops at those margins (boundary inferred; no vertical datum printed). Two thicknesses with OCR'd digits ('less than | foot', '4 to 5) feet') read as likely digits (inferred). Whole-page image checked: the schematic diagram of terrace systems and the idealized facies diagram print no elevations, distances, holes or contacts, so no section is recorded; no drill holes or structure contours. Karst: limestone and calcareous sediments less than 40 feet beneath the surface (areal statement). Water unit, roads and photo locations not recorded.
